gen-dafont-origami-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC is a serif with gentle modulation and dignified, cast-iron stature. Origami above it is a thread of ink with no swelling at all, so the body's soft weight shifts feel almost tender by comparison.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-montagu-slab: Origami draws its strokes like a bent paperclip, one constant width throughout. Origami is best at being unmistakable, while Montagu Slab, a classic serif with sturdy downstrokes and a generous x-height, does the quiet work of being read.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-serif-hentaig: Origami ends every stroke at the same measured thickness, a lowercase mass that looks poured rather than written. Origami makes the statement; Noto Serif Hentaigana carries the shimmering detail.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-ovo: Origami's line is spaghetti laid out in letters, unswelling from start to finish. Spectacle is the heading's job; Ovo, a classic serif with a tall middle band and a dip pen's mild variation, takes the reading.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-domine: Outrun Future traces every letter in a constant-width outline, wide-set and synthwave. Domine, a classic serif, settles into paragraphs with compact ascenders and a soft step from heavy to light strokes, so reading keeps moving.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-esteban: Esteban is a text serif whose lowercase looks oversized beside its own capitals. Esteban's soft brush-pressed shifts sit beneath Outrun Future's bent-pipe-cleaner texture, giving everything a taut line above and a gentler one below.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-faustina: Faustina is a serif with gently thinning bowls and a pliers-wide c. Next to Outrun Future, whose n has arch and stem matching exactly, it feels like a steady hand beside a ruler.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-halant: Wire-straight and wide-set, Outrun Future pulls its strokes like solder through a nozzle. And Halant, a text serif with a faint thick-thin shift and tall x-height, reads steadily through paragraphs.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-hedvig-lette: Authoritative up top, Outrun Future sketches wide-set letters in one steady pencil. What they share most is authority: Hedvig Letters Serif, a text serif with open-ended curves, backs it with a worn stamp's restraint.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-lisu-bosa: Editorial by nature, Lisu Bosa is a serif with sturdy, large-looking words. Outrun Future's true monoline drawing sits beside Lisu Bosa's middle path between monoline and razor-thin hairlines, which sharpens both.
